advisory_findings: Report advisory unknowns and violations separately; they do not alone fail the required-check primary measure. Essentiality follows the accepted request and adopted policy, not a blanket missing-history penalty.
assessment_completeness: Checker errors and missing expected assessments remain external assessment failures. Retain known partial violations separately; do not convert an absent checker result into semantic unknown or a model violation.
case_scoring_ready: An externally supplied prerequisite in artificial fixtures; not an implemented case-acceptance validator or proof of reference readiness.
case_success: Require the designated returned response, valid shared parsing, required plan and activity content, request completeness, and every required applicable check met.

coverage.interpretation: Conclusive coverage is not a pass rate.
coverage.unit: expected parent checks, not number of activity instances

empty_mask: A bare empty, missing or advisory-only obligation list cannot establish required-check readiness in this component. Reviewed non-applicability is an explicit required parent assessment with an evidence basis; required plan/completeness gates still apply. This readiness hold is not a planner failure.

evidence_ratios.attribution_coverage: Source-dependent claims with usable attribution / source-dependent claims reviewed
evidence_ratios.cited_claim_support: Supported cited claims / cited claims assessed
evidence_ratios.empty_denominator: Unavailable, with counts. No supplied IDs does not mean perfect attribution. ID validity and factual support remain separate.
evidence_ratios.id_validity: Resolvable distinct IDs / supplied distinct IDs

execution: Unstarted or awaiting permitted resumption is incomplete. Terminal timeout, failed execution or missing designated response prevents success without requiring downstream activity assessments.
expectation_boundary: Expected obligations and applicability must come from accepted private annotations and adopted public contracts/rules/policies before final outputs. This helper does not prepare or approve them.
expected_instances: Instances needed for the parent condition, established by adopted applicability. Keep unrelated advisory/optional findings separate from required conditions.
format_and_independence: Optional source-ID fields remain optional. Version4 internal acceptance does not determine the external outcome; earlier diagnostic drafts cannot replace the designated response after fatal execution.
human_review: Preserve malformed but readable returned text for later independent human review; no automated human scores or reviewer decisions are assigned here.
parent_aggregation: An established violation dominates. Otherwise necessary unknowns prevent met. Preserve all instance findings and evidence; justified non-applicability needs a reason and evidence reference.
population_readiness: These counts are design targets. Do not calculate final rates from unaccepted drafts, drop failed jobs, or describe an incomplete experiment as complete.
primary_measure: Successful feasible cases divided by all 150 accepted feasible final cases per version once the declared roster and assessment are complete.
response_assessment: Malformed output, missing required plan, incomplete scope or omitted required activity content prevents success. Unavailable or failed external parsing/assessment remains incomplete.
scope: Pure aggregation of supplied artificial facts. No planner text, profile content, rule thresholds, source lookups or model calls are evaluated.
scoring_complete_scope: The case calculator's scoring_complete flag resolves its primary disposition only. A decisive missing response or incomplete-plan failure does not certify every ancillary assessment as finished. Preserve any existing checker-error ledger and unresolved coverage independently; this flag alone cannot finalize an experiment.
